overview: The Echo Archives store Akhevan knowledge through resonance‑encoded memory strands and void‑arcane echo preservation.
history: Founded during the earliest Akhevan era to preserve ritual knowledge.
Luclinite data spires were added to stabilize long‑term memory echoes.
Void‑arcane echo chambers expanded to support advanced research.
Praesertum decrees formalized the Archives as a civic institution.
Modern Archives serve as both research center and historical vault.
hooks: A memory echo destabilizes and threatens archival integrity.
A scholar requests assistance retrieving a corrupted echo strand.
A void‑arcane chamber experiences anomalous fluctuations.
A Praesertum directive restricts access to certain archives.
